newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CS reshuffles some Zurich operations.
newsitem.headline: CS reshuffles some Zurich operations.

text.p: Credit Suisse Group is cutting some 700 jobs from the Zurich staff of its Credit Suisse First Boston (CSFB) unit and shifting a portion of those positions to the information technology segment of its private banking operations, a CSFB spokesman said.

Some of the 700 positions will be transferred to the group's Credit Suisse Private Banking unit's information technology operations and some eliminated, the spokesman said, but he gave no specific details.
The move is part of a broader restructuring of Credit Suisse Group's operations. These measures should be completed by the end of the year, he added.
Credit Suisse last July announced a major restructuring which included the creation of four business units and staff reductions of about 5,000.
The reorganisation also called for the integration of all the group's global investment banking business within CSFB, which would be based in London. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
